You can download online images yourself. Alternatively, you can purchase copies of various types.

Purchasing Copies

description: "Follow the Music: Exploring Multi-Linear Legacies of House Culture" aims to expand upon the common narratives documenting a wider range of community voices that define the multi-linear legacies of House Music and Dance Cultures (HMDC). This collection documents the culture of Black and Brown urban communities through dance forms including Breakin', House, Hip Hop, Popping/Boogaloo, and locking. This includes oral histories documenting community voices in Washington, D.C.; Baltimore, Maryland; Chicago, Illinois; New York, New York; Los Angeles, California; and Oakland, California.
